Should we wish to obscure our movements against the machine entity, send it false information or otherwise interfere with it: its own protocols may now be weaponized against it.

descriptions.zh: 间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]发回报告：到目前为止此项计划进展顺利。我们刚刚招募了一名有价值的线人，此人会协助我们在[from.target.GetAdj]国内的情报搜集工作和间谍活动。
descriptions.en: Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports from the [from.target.GetName]: a successful execution so far. We have secured a valuable Asset which will bolster our intelligence-gathering and espionage activities inside [from.target.GetAdj] space.

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工已经确保了我们在[root.target.GetName]受邀出席的在一次星际科学会议上的方便。我们的工作重点仅是侦察[root.target.GetAdj]代表团。
descriptions.en: Our operatives have secured attendance at an interstellar, scientific conference to which the [root.target.GetName] have also been invited. Our efforts are focused on scouting only the [root.target.GetAdj] delegation.

descriptions.zh: 我们潜伏的特工们已经完全渗透了[root.target.GetAdj]国内举办的一次尖端云集的会议上。他们已经开始寻找那些潜在目标。
descriptions.en: Our undercover operatives are dispersed throughout a promising-looking conference being held in [root.target.GetAdj] space. They have begun scouting potential targets.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经安排了一些特工在[root.target.GetName]上举办的讲座中充当观众。他们将会在这些知识精英中寻找潜在的领袖。
descriptions.en: We have placed operatives in the audience at a number of lectures being held in the [root.target.GetName]. We will watch for potential leads amongst their intellectual elite.

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工分散在[root.target.GetName]为造福他们自己的公民而运行的各种科学宣传计划中。我们的行动目的就是想对这些计划有所了解。
descriptions.en: Our operatives have dispersed amongst the various scientific outreach schemes being run by the [root.target.GetName] for the benefit of their own citizenry. Our target for this endeavor may very well just make themselves known to us.

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工已经开始监视[root.target.GetAdj]上的一座研究设施。我们会利用一切存在的切入点。
descriptions.en: Our operatives have begun surveilling a [root.target.GetAdj] research facility. Wherever an entry point exists, we shall exploit it.

descriptions.zh:
间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告称，我们特工的行动遇到了不可逾越的障碍：[target.GetAdj]的工程技术突飞猛进，远远甩开了我们。

任何可能从他们那里窃取的技术都已变得§H浑不可解§!——且与我们现有的技术体系不兼容。
descriptions.en:
Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our operatives have met an insurmountable obstacle: [target.GetAdj] engineering appears to have advanced and deviated far from our own.

Any technology we might hope to steal from them would be §Hinscrutable§! to us - as well as incompatible with what we currently possess.

descriptions.zh: 我们的一个潜在目标似乎具有我们需要的科研许可，并且他们对我们伪造的证书深信不疑。这似乎是我们目前最大的优势。
descriptions.en: One of our potential targets seems to have the kind of research clearance we need, and they are suitably impressed by our fabricated credentials. This lead seems our best one for now.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经找到了一个符合我们预期标准的目标：能够获得足够前沿的研究成果，同时对于我们的特工持友好态度。我们将会继续跟进这名领袖。
descriptions.en: We have found a target who meets our ideal criteria: access to sufficiently novel research, and a receptive attitude towards our operative. We will continue to pursue this lead.

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工已经找到了缺口——这对于我们渗透连接到[root.target.GetAdj]相关研究的计划来说是一个理想的基石。
descriptions.en: Our operatives have found an opening - an ideal foundation upon which to build our plans to infiltrate [root.target.GetAdj] research.

options.script: name = OK

descriptions.zh: 我们已经制定了多种具有明显优势的计划：我们的特工终于被邀请到一个从事尖端研究的高级别安全分支机构。间谍首脑[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]向我们保证，[root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的预测显示计划前景良好。
descriptions.en: We have drawn up various plans which press a clear advantage: our operative has at last been invited to a high-security branch facility engaged in cutting-edge research. Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] assures us that [root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] simulations paint a favorable forecast.

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工现在已经执行了大量的测试行动，其结果与来自间谍首脑[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]的有利预测高度一致。我们对于觊觎已久的[root.target.GetAdj]上的研究已经完全做好了准备。
descriptions.en: Our operatives have now performed numerous test runs, the results of which concur with favorable forecasts from Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]. We stand ready to make our attempt on coveted [root.target.GetAdj] research.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetName]的渗透行为迄今还没有露出任何马脚。

一个特工已经通过§H公用通道§!获取了通往一个远程科研设施内部的权限，他正慢慢地迂回前进，直到接触[fromfrom.target.GetName]限制访问的中央资料库的终端。一系列复杂的电子幕墙和威慑机关现在已经停摆，研究数据库现在完全暴露在我们面前，时间恰好足够我们进行行动。在我们完成这里的任务之后，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]将重新大门紧闭。
descriptions.en:
Our infiltration attempt in the [fromfrom.target.GetName] has proceeded flawlessly so far.

A single operative has gained access to the interior of a remote research facility via its §Hutility ducts§!, having slowly wound their way to a restricted-access terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository. A complex series of electronic blinds and bluffs has exposed the research database for just long enough to make our move. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security will clamp down tightly after we're done here.

descriptions.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro$

我们的一位特工藏在了一处远程研究设施的§H货物入口§!，等待运输人员将其带过几道明显很不充分的[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]安全关卡。一个脑子不好使的[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesAdj]将我们的特工放在了一个能够很轻松够到终端的地方，可以从这里入侵[fromfrom.target.GetName]的中央资料库。

一系列复杂的电子幕墙和威慑机关现在已经停摆，研究数据库现在完全暴露在我们面前，时间恰好足够我们进行行动。在我们完成这里的任务之后，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]将重新大门紧闭。
descriptions.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro$

A single operative hid within the §Hgoods entrance§! of a remote research facility, waiting to be couriered past a number of clearly-inadequate [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security measures. An unwitting [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesAdj] has placed our operative within easy reach of a terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository.

A complex series of electronic blinds and bluffs has exposed the research database for just long enough to make our move. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security will clamp down tightly after we're done here.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]科学部门的渗透成功了，但是现在我们的一些特工处于风险之中。

一个特工已经通过§H公用通道§!获取了通往一个远程科研设施内部的权限，正试图前往核心区域的一处访问受限制的终端。然而，当他获取[fromfrom.target.GetName]中央存放室的权限时，§H警报§!触发了。

我们想要的研究数据已经被获取到了，但是我们团队的§H逃脱计划§!被打乱了。当前的安全措施十分严密，我们必须小心的思考我们的下一步行动……
descriptions.en:
Our infiltration of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] science has succeeded, however some of our operatives now appear to be at risk.

They sought access to the interior of a remote research facility via its §Hutility ducts§!, intending to reach a restricted-access terminal at its core. When they accessed the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository, however, §Han alarm§! was tripped.

 The research data we desired has already been extracted, but our team's §Hescape plans§! have been thrown into disarray. Security is coming down hard; we must carefully and promptly consider our next move.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]科学部门的渗透成功了，但是现在我们的一些特工处于风险之中。

我们的一位特工试图通过§H货运通道§!访问某个远程研究设施的内部，货运人员直接将此人输运到了一处可以接入[fromfrom.target.GetName]中央存放室的终端。然而不幸的是，刚打算行动的时候§H警报§!就触发了。

我们想要的研究数据已经被获取到了，但是我们团队的§H逃脱计划§!被打乱了。当前的安全措施十分严密，我们必须小心的思考我们的下一步行动……
descriptions.en:
Our infiltration of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] science has succeeded, however some of our operatives now appear to be at risk.

A single operative sought access to the interior of a remote research facility via its §Hgoods yard§!, having themselves delivered straight to a terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository. Unfortunately §Han alarm§! appears to have been tripped the moment they made their move.

The research data we desired has already been extracted, but our team's §Hescape plans§! have been thrown into disarray. Security is coming down hard; we must carefully and promptly consider our next move.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetName]的渗透行为迄今还没有露出任何马脚。尽管[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName]执行了必要的安全措施，我们的特工隐蔽工作做得更为彻底：我们§H制造的信任感§!给了我们充足的机会窗口。

一系列复杂的电子幕墙和威慑机关现在已经停摆，研究数据库现在完全暴露在我们面前，时间恰好足够我们进行行动。在我们完成这里的任务之后，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]将重新大门紧闭。
descriptions.en:
Our infiltration attempt in the [fromfrom.target.GetName] has proceeded flawlessly so far. Our operative's cover held throughout, and although the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] exercised reasonable security: the §Htrust we manufactured§! was just sufficient to grant us our window of opportunity.

A complex series of electronic blinds and bluffs has exposed the research database for just long enough to make our move. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security will clamp down tightly after we're done here.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]科学部门的渗透成功了，但是现在我们的一些特工处于风险之中。我们的首席特工设法利用一个假身份完成了获取，但是他的§H身份§!现在已经被识破了，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]已经通知了他们的安全部门。

我们想要的研究数据已经被获取到了，但是我们团队的§H逃脱计划§!被打乱了。当前的安全措施十分严密，我们必须小心的思考我们的下一步行动……
descriptions.en:
Our infiltration of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] science has succeeded, however some of our operatives now appear to be at risk. Our lead operative's cover held long enough to complete their extraction, but their §Hcredentials§! have now been exposed as false. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security has been alerted to their presence.

The research data we desired has already been extracted, but our team's §Hescape plans§! have been thrown into disarray. Security is coming down hard; we must carefully and promptly consider our next move.

label.zh: 找回我们的特工，能找回来多少就找回来多少！
label.en: Retrieve as many of our operatives as possible.

label.zh: 把我们带不走的全炸了。

tooltips.zh:
§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!：
受到§Y研究破坏§!损害，持续1年。
tooltips.en:
§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!:
Afflicted by §YResearch Sabotaged§! for 1 year.

label.zh: 留一个后门，方便我们随时检索他们未来的研究。
label.en: Give us backdoor-access to their future research.

label.zh: 好机会，我们应该再多抢一点！
label.en: This is an ideal opportunity to seize more!

tooltips.zh: 我们有一项额外科技可以进行研究，并且我们已经得到该条目。
tooltips.en: An additional technology is made available for research, as well as the item we have attained.

descriptions.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]提交了一份报告，事关§H[from.target.GetName]§!境内的[from.GetName]行动。似乎看上去[from.target.GetAdj]的科学和工程学已经先进到了可以欺瞒我方最专业的特工的地步了。他们宣称其内部技术和我们自己的科技截然不同，即使我们设法偷到了一两项科技，仿制出来的硬件也无法和我们自己的兼容

间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]建议我们去其他的地方再窃取类似的秘密。
descriptions.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has submitted a report on Operation [from.GetName], inside the §H[from.target.GetName]§!. It seems that [from.target.GetAdj] science and engineering have advanced to the point of bamboozling our expert operatives. They claim that the underlying technology has deviated greatly from our own, meaning that even if we could somehow steal their research, the resulting hardware would be incompatible with ours.

Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] suggests that we appropriate such secrets elsewhere.

options.script: name = INTRIGUING

descriptions.zh:
我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，§H偷窃研究成果§!为他们所用，§H正在进行的研究§!已经陷入瘫痪。

我们的团队已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢他们的进度。我们预计需要几个月的时间，我们才能利用已保存的纸面材料，重新整合研究开发进度。
descriptions.en:
Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown infiltrator has upended many of our data libraries, §Hstealing research§! for their own use and causing significant delays to our §Hongoing studies§!.

Our teams were able to switch to backup systems quite rapidly, but this will slow their progress. It's estimated that months may pass before we're able to re-integrate our research & development processes with the existing corpus.

descriptions.zh:
我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，§H偷窃研究成果§!为他们所用，§H正在进行的研究§!已经陷入瘫痪。

我们已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢进度。我们需要几个月的时间才能利用已恢复的研究数据集来重新整合研究开发进度。
descriptions.en:
Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown entity has infiltrated our data media, §Hstealing research§! for their own use and causing significant disruption to our §Hongoing studies§!.

We were able to engage backup systems quite rapidly, but our progress from here will be slowed down. Months may pass before we're able to smoothly re-integrate research & development with our existing research libraries.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_gestalt = yes }

descriptions.zh: 一小队精挑细选的特工在经过严密伪装之后出发前往§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!境内。每一个人都会装作一名求职者。一部分人将会携带推荐信，找和关键设施运营相关的工作；其他人则要在背地里试试运气。
descriptions.en: A small and select group of operatives has departed for the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§! under tight aliases. Each will pose as a worker seeking employment. Some are carrying statements of recommendation and will seek work close to key facilities; others will try their luck in shadier parts of the installation.

descriptions.zh: 一小队精挑细选的特工在经过严密伪装之后出发前往§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!境内。他们中间有一个假扮工匠家庭，希望能够寻得新的生意机遇。他们会尝试在§H[target.GetName]§!摆零售地摊以出售自己的手工制品。
descriptions.en: A small and select group of operatives has departed for the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§! under tight aliases. Amongst them is a supposed family of artisans, seeking new business opportunities. They will try to establish a retail presence on §H[target.GetName]§! in order to sell their wares.

descriptions.zh: 一批专业的特工已经到达§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!境内。他们使用一艘不起眼的货运飞船作为掩护。这艘舰船在接近[target.owner.GetAdj]国境的时候被安排了一场非致命性的爆炸，使得其尽可能接近§H[target.solar_system.GetName]§!星系。辐射将会倾泻出来充满了整个船舱内部，这样我们的特工就能秘密隐藏在它不可见的受保护核心中。
descriptions.en: A batch of operatives has left for the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§!. Their cover involves piloting a nondescript cargo vessel. The ship is rigged for a non-lethal explosion as it approaches the [target.owner.GetAdj] border - as close as it can get to the §H[target.solar_system.GetName] system§!. Radiation will appear to flood the interior of the vessel as our operatives secrete themselves within its invisibly-shielded core.

descriptions.zh: 一批专业的特工已经到达§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!境内。他们使用一艘不起眼的货运飞船作为掩护。它的货架上装满了对[target.owner.GetAdj]的扫描器会显示为稀有水晶和其他珍贵矿物的物件。我们相信，最简单直白的策略能够达到最好的障眼法效果。
descriptions.en: A batch of operatives has left for the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§!. Their cover involves piloting a nondescript cargo vessel. Its hold is packed with what will appear to [target.owner.GetAdj] scanners as Rare Crystals and other precious minerals. We trust that the bare-faced simplicity of this strategy will serve as its own bluff.

descriptions.zh: 我方特工报告[root.target.owner.GetAdj]的国内已经发生了剧烈的变化：我们的目标不再有效。
descriptions.en: Our operatives report drastic changes within the [root.target.owner.GetAdj] interior: our target is no longer viable.

options.script: name = ACKNOWLEDGED

descriptions.zh: 我方的数名特工已经被允许登陆§H[target.GetName]§!设施。其他未获得授权的特工则继续分散在邻近星系。在这里他们可以转换成备用的掩护身份以进一步支援整个行动。
descriptions.en: A number of our operatives have been accepted aboard the §H[target.GetName] facility§!. Those who haven't been granted work there have dispersed to neighboring systems. There they will switch to backup cover identities and lend support to the overall operation.

descriptions.zh: 对方已经上钩了，我们的特工已经“遁入黑暗”，进而在敌对设施内部展开工作。间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]将会等待进一步的讯息信号。
descriptions.en: The bait has been taken, and our operatives have 'gone dark' as they work to establish themselves within the hostile facility. Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] will await further signals from them.

descriptions.zh: 我方特工报告[root.target.owner.GetAdj]的国内已经发生了剧烈的变化：我们的目标不再有效。
descriptions.en: Our operatives report drastic changes within the [root.target.owner.GetAdj] interior: our target is no longer viable.

options.script: name = ACKNOWLEDGED

descriptions.zh:
一段加密的信号自§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!传来，表明我们的特工现在已经准备就绪。

他们的身份伪装已经深入到了一定程度，我们的特工事实上已经和那里的人员打成一片。通过友情聚餐、共享娱乐，以及日常社交活动，他们在§H[target.GetName]设施§!获得了不少能用于进入核心系统的线索。
descriptions.en:
A coded signal has arrived from within the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§!, indicating that our operatives now stand ready.

They have worked their cover roles to such a degree, our operatives have actually developed a rapport with local personnel. A number of useful points of entry have been noted during friendly meals, shared entertainments and day-to-day socializing aboard the §H[target.GetName] facility§!.

descriptions.zh: 一段加密的信号自§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!传来，表明我们的特工现在已经准备就绪。间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经着手准备在可能的情况下撤出他们，然而机会十分渺茫。
descriptions.en: A coded signal has arrived from within the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§!, indicating that our operatives now stand ready. Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has made preparations to extract them where possible, however their chances are slim.

descriptions.zh: 我方特工报告[root.target.owner.GetAdj]的国内已经发生了剧烈的变化：我们的目标不再有效。
descriptions.en: Our operatives report drastic changes within the [root.target.owner.GetAdj] interior: our target is no longer viable.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功地破坏了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施上面的§H军用支援结构§!。我们的特工报道了在他们的设备激活后，周边工作的人出现了少量的伤亡。

我们发动的这次打击扰乱了§Y[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName]§!的作战后勤，对方不会对其视而不见的。

我们现在必须考虑能否为我们的行动开脱。在未来任何针对[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]空间的行动都需要我们尽可能地维持掩护——也就是说，我们要把慎重放在第一要位……
descriptions.en:
We have successfully sabotaged a §Hmilitary support structure§! aboard the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. Our operatives report minor casualties amongst those working nearby at the time their device activated.

This blow we've dealt to combat logistics within the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName]§! will not go unnoticed by them.

We must now consider the deniability of our own actions. Any future operations in [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] space will require us to maintain as much cover as we can - that is, assuming we wish to prioritize such discretion...

descriptions.zh:
我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系及其周边的§H商业利益§!发动了一次打击。由于当地星系的交通控制者手忙脚乱地制定新的物流模式，贸易舰船已经堵塞了所有的运输航线。

我们现在必须考虑能否为我们的行动开脱。在未来任何针对[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]空间的行动都需要我们尽可能地维持掩护——也就是说，我们要把慎重放在第一要位……
descriptions.en:
We have struck a blow to §Hcommercial interests§! in and around the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. Trading vessels are already clogging up the shipping lanes as local space traffic controllers scramble to draw up new holding patterns.

We must now consider the deniability of our own actions. Any future operations in [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] space will require us to maintain as much cover as we can - that is, assuming we wish to prioritize such discretion...

descriptions.zh:
我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系内的§H民用设施§!进行了一次成功的爆破。随后而来的混乱证明了我们目标的成功实现。

我们现在必须考虑能否为我们的行动开脱。在未来任何针对[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]空间的行动都需要我们尽可能地维持掩护——也就是说，我们要把慎重放在第一要位……
descriptions.en:
We have struck a a successful blow to §Hcivic infrastructure§! in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. The ensuing chaos should serve our goals well.

We must now consider the deniability of our own actions. Any future operations in [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] space will require us to maintain as much cover as we can - that is, assuming we wish to prioritize such discretion...

label.zh: 谨慎是留给懦夫的。拆毁这个恒星基地。
label.en: Discretion is for the meek. Wreck this starbase.

label.zh: 也对防御平台发动打击。
label.en: Strike at the Defense Platforms as well.

tooltips.zh: 摧毁一座目标上的防御平台。
tooltips.en: Destroys a Defense Platform on the target.

descriptions.zh: 间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告道，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的特工小队必须放弃目前打算破坏§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!位于§H[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]星系目标§!的计划。[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]内部发生了急剧的变化，我们之前的准备工作成为了赘余。我们应该明智地挑选一个不同的目标。
descriptions.en: Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] team of operatives must abandon their efforts to sabotage §H[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]§! in the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system§!. Drastic changes to the [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] interior have made our efforts so far redundant. We would be wise to choose a different target.

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

descriptions.zh: 入侵者们已经越过了我们在§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!星系的边境，并破坏了§H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]§!设施的一部分。这些破坏分子显然是在为某个外国势力卖命；我们的反间谍部队必须提高警戒并尝试抓住这些特工。
descriptions.en: Intruders have violated our borders in the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§! system, wrecking part of the §H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility§!. These saboteurs appear to have been acting on behalf of a foreign power; our counter-espionage forces are on high alert to try and capture these operatives.

descriptions.zh:
未知的破坏分子在§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!星系发动了袭击，破坏了§H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施§!的部分功能。

我们的反间谍部门推断这是外国势力从中作梗而不是本国的威胁。我们已经提高了受影响宇域的安全等级，希望能够擒拿这些特工。
descriptions.en:
Unknown saboteurs have struck at the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§! system, wrecking part of the §H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility§!.

Our counter-espionage service suggests this is likely the work of foreign actors, rather than any home-grown threat. We have increased security around the affected region of space in the hopes of capturing these operatives.

descriptions.zh: 一个外国实体突破了我们位于§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!星系的边境，放肆地扰乱了§H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施§!的平稳运行。我们暂时无法确信这些破坏分子是如何如此有效地进入我国国界，但是我们提高了内部的安全级别以直接应对这次威胁。
descriptions.en: A foreign entity has breached our borders in the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§! system and has wantonly disrupted the smooth running of §H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility§!. We cannot yet ascertain how these saboteurs gained entry so effectively, however we have increased our internal security in direct response.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经编纂了一份列表，上面包含对§Y[root.target.GetName]§!友好的帝国。我们的特工会在这些帝国直接制造裂痕。
descriptions.en: We have compiled a list of those empires who appear friendliest to the §Y[root.target.GetName]§!. Our operatives will drive a wedge between these empires.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一个前途无量的目标——§H[event_target:smear_option_1.GetName]§!——他们同§Y[root.target.GetName]§!的关系利于[root.target.GetAdj]的利益而于我们有害。
descriptions.en: We have found a promising target - the §H[event_target:smear_option_1.GetName]§! - whose relationship with the §Y[root.target.GetName]§! benefits [root.target.GetAdj] interests to our own detriment.

descriptions.zh: 我们没能发现这个方面合适的目标。看来如果§Y[root.target.GetName]§!真的在其他地方有盟友，我们也还并没有同他们建立联系。
descriptions.en: We are unable to find a suitable target for this endeavor. It seems that if the §Y[root.target.GetName]§! do have friends elsewhere, we have yet to establish lines of communication with them.

descriptions.zh: 由间谍首脑[Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队会开展工作，放大[root.target.GetName]内部的宗教偏狭。我们会放出可信度很高的谣言，[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的宗教仪式习俗在[root.target.GetAdj]的政治圈内部已经成为了公开的笑料。
descriptions.en: The team under Spymaster [Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName] will work to exaggerate religious intolerance amongst the [root.target.GetName]. We will spread credible rumors that [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] ritual practices are the subject of open ridicule in [root.target.GetAdj] political circles.

descriptions.zh: 由间谍首脑[Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队会开展工作，放大[root.target.GetName]内部的宗教偏狭。如果他们被抓到兜售廉价、渎神的圣像，而[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]恰好将视其为神明，那么……
descriptions.en: The team under Spymaster [Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName] will work to exaggerate religious intolerance amongst the [root.target.GetName]. If they were seen to be peddling cheap and blasphemous idols from whatever the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] hold most sacred, for example...

descriptions.zh: 由间谍首脑[Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队会开展工作，放大[root.target.GetName]内部的宗教偏狭。我们会伪造一场[root.target.GetAdj]运动，目标直指那些[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]内非祭司阶层的人。要想扰乱宗教教团的政治，就得攻击那些负责运作的人。
descriptions.en: The team under Spymaster [Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName] will work to exaggerate religious intolerance amongst the [root.target.GetName]. We will fabricate a [root.target.GetAdj] campaign targeting those outside of the priest caste in the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. An attempt to disrupt the politics of their religious order is bound to offend those who run it.

descriptions.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。我们可以暗示[root.target.GetAdj]之所以对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]感兴趣是为了研究其军事机密，并且一旦他们暴露出任何弱点，对方便可能会发动战争。
descriptions.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. We can suggest that [root.target.GetAdj] interests in the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] are solely motivated by studying their military secrets, and that they might go as far as instigating war to test any weaknesses they've exposed.

descriptions.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。[root.target.GetName]应当因为关押[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的战犯并意图教化他们而受到控告，例如……
descriptions.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. Should the [root.target.GetName] be accused of withholding [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] prisoners of war with the intention of indoctrinating them, for example...

descriptions.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。我们可以提供不容辩驳的证词，证明[root.target.GetName]明明知道武器有瑕疵，却依然睁一只眼闭一只眼将武器给他们的星系邻居，即[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]。
descriptions.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. We shall supply incontrovertible evidence that the [root.target.GetName] are selling cleverly-disguised, defective weaponry to their esteemed galactic neighbors, the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。放出有关[root.target.GetAdj]在技术上获得突破的谣言，这项技术能够强制平定像[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]这样的邻国，比如说……
descriptions.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. Rumors of a breakthrough in [root.target.GetAdj] technology which would forcibly pacify neighbors like the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], for example...

descriptions.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。我们刺激他们的自尊心，暗示[root.target.GetName]用对战[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的场景来训练他们最年轻的新兵，以此来帮新兵建立能打胜仗的信心。
descriptions.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. We will appeal to their sense of pride, suggesting that the [root.target.GetName] train only their youngest cadets on combat scenarios against the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], as a means of easily building their confidence.

descriptions.zh: 我们会夸大[root.target.GetName]的外族傲慢，挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外本性。比如说：如果[root.target.GetName]被抓到正在售卖基于[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]生物学的基因疗法，他们一定会暴跳如雷。
descriptions.en: We will exaggerate the alien arrogance of the [root.target.GetName], appealing to the xenophobic heart of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. For example: were the [root.target.GetName] to be caught selling gene therapies based on [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] biology, they are bound to take umbrage.

descriptions.zh: 我们会夸大[root.target.GetName]的外族傲慢，挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外本性。我们会播种这样一个想法，[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋绑架[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的公民，并教化他们接受一个更加开放的宇宙。
descriptions.en: We will exaggerate the alien arrogance of the [root.target.GetName], appealing to the xenophobic heart of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. We will seed ideas about a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to abduct [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] citizens and indoctrinate them into accepting a more open galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描述成为政治体系最激烈的破坏者，正如[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]抱有的成见那样。要是[root.target.GetName]被抓到没有遵守他们的移民条约，并且专门针对[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的公民，让他们去干脏活累活，想必有人会觉得受到了冒犯。
descriptions.en: We will portray the [root.target.GetName] as keen saboteurs to political systems like that which the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] holds dear. Were the [root.target.GetName] to be caught dishonoring their migration treaty, and singling out [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] citizens for worse jobs, offense would have to be taken.

descriptions.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描述成为政治体系最激烈的破坏者，正如[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]抱有的成见那样。我们应该拐弯抹角地暗示[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋破坏他们在星海共同体的政治立场。
descriptions.en: We will portray the [root.target.GetName] as keen saboteurs to political systems like that which the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] holds dear. We shall lay hints of a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to sabotage their political standing within the Galactic Community.

descriptions.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描述成为政治体系最激烈的破坏者，正如[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]抱有的成见那样。我们可以提供不容忽视的证据，指明[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋渗透[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的政治体系，并试图干涉大选。
descriptions.en: We will portray the [root.target.GetName] as keen saboteurs to political systems like that which the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] holds dear. We can supply hard-to-ignore evidence of a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to infiltrate the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] political system and meddle in their elections.

descriptions.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描绘成嫉妒而贪婪的邻国，总是想方设法地剥削和滥用[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的科学成果。我们可以放出高可信度的谣言，造谣有人密谋窃取他们的科技，这应该有利于我们的目标。
descriptions.en: We will paint the [root.target.GetName] as jealous and greedy neighbors, keen to exploit and abuse [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] science. Credible rumors of a plot to outright steal their technology should serve us well in this goal.

descriptions.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描绘成嫉妒而贪婪的邻国，总是想方设法地剥削和滥用[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的科学成果。我们应当捏造一个[root.target.GetName]国内的运动组织，去窃取[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的机器人，绕过他们自己有限的生产手段。
descriptions.en: We will paint the [root.target.GetName] as jealous and greedy neighbors, keen to exploit and abuse [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] science. We shall concoct a movement within the [root.target.GetName] to steal [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] droids, bypassing their own limited means of production.

descriptions.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描绘成嫉妒而贪婪的邻国，总是想方设法地剥削和滥用[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的科学成果。造谣[root.target.GetAdj]有能力产生威胁，在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的数据库内部引爆一个受控的、由人工智能主导的奇点，这样的消息应该能够吸引他们的注意和怒火。
descriptions.en: We will paint the [root.target.GetName] as jealous and greedy neighbors, keen to exploit and abuse [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] science. A [root.target.GetAdj] threat of sparking a controlled, AI-driven singularity within the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] datasphere ought to draw their attention and ire.

descriptions.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描绘成嫉妒而贪婪的邻国，总是想方设法地剥削和滥用[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的科学成果。[root.target.GetAdj]可能正在密谋破坏科学研究，这样的消息肯定能够引起他们一定的反感。
descriptions.en: We will paint the [root.target.GetName] as jealous and greedy neighbors, keen to exploit and abuse [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] science. That the [root.target.GetAdj] might be plotting to sabotage that scientific research would be sure to draw some sort of reaction from them.

descriptions.zh: 我们可以激发[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]和平主义者的恐惧，将暴力活动归咎于[root.target.GetName]。举个例子：[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]政权可能不会乐意听到[root.target.GetAdj]在他们国内贩卖枪火并以此获利。
descriptions.en: We will appeal to the fears of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] pacifism, pinning violent agendas upon the [root.target.GetName]. descriptions.zh:
§Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§!向我们提交了一份档案，在其中详尽阐述了复杂的间谍指控，意在挑拨离间。似乎§H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!希望在我们之间散布不信任。

虽然[smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj]行动是隐秘进行的，但依然不是[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]编码手段的对手。他们最终选择不再保留这些秘密，而是向我们公开他们的档案。
descriptions.en:
The §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§! have delivered a dossier to us, detailing complex allegations of espionage which were intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. It seems the §H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§! wish to sow distrust between us.

Although the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj] operation was carried out in secrecy, it was apparently no match for [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] Encryption. Instead of keeping that knowledge to themselves, they have chosen to open their files to us.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§!向我们提交了一份措辞巧妙的档案，提及§H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!，声称其意图对我们不利。若这份[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]文件可信，则说明[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]意图以我们的名义散布谣言以破坏我们与[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的关系。

虽然[smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj]行动是隐秘进行的，但依然不是[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]编码手段的对手。他们最终选择不再保留这些秘密，而是向我们公开他们的档案。
descriptions.en:
The §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§! have approached us with a delicately-worded dossier on the §H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!, who seem to wish us ill. If the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] files are to be believed, the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] intended to damage any relationship between us and the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] by seeding slanderous lies in our name.

Although the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj] operation was carried out in secrecy, it was apparently no match for [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] Encryption. Instead of keeping that knowledge to themselves, they have chosen to open their files to us.

descriptions.zh: 间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组。所有人员都将作为独狼参与其中，并已经做好了单程票的准备。他们现在只等一个目标-一个值得将其引向§H[target.GetName]§!重大灾难。
descriptions.en: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives. Those involved will work alone, and are prepared for the fact this will almost certainly be a one-way trip. All they need now is a target - a worthy catastrophe to draw towards the §H[target.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组，他们将设法把§P[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]§!引诱至§H[target.GetAdj]§!领土上。预计将全队覆灭。
descriptions.en: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives who will seek to lure the §P[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]§! directly into §H[target.GetAdj]§! territory. The team is not expected to return.

descriptions.zh: 间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]这次报告道，§Y没有危机级别威胁§!被这样一次行动引诱到。[spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]所召集到的特工将保持待命，直到我们对这个肆虐整个星系的毁灭灾厄有了更进一步的了解。
descriptions.en: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that at this time, §Yno crisis-level threats§! are likely to be lured in by such an operation. The operatives [spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] assembled will remain on standby until we know more about the catastrophic threats lurking in this galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 我们的研究员与特工们已准备好应对各种任务突发变数，特遣队也已前往§Y[target.GetAdj]§!与§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!之间的未知区域。
descriptions.en: Our researchers and operatives have prepared for a wide variety of mission variables, and the task team has departed for an uncharted region of space between §Y[target.GetAdj] territory§! and the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[target.GetName]§!附近的特工们发出了一条单方面通讯：他们已经准备好继续执行任务，一但我们发出指令，他们就将去触怒§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: Our operatives near the §H[target.GetName]§! have sent a one-time communiqué: they are ready to proceed, and will draw the ire of the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§! upon our signal.

descriptions.zh:
我们的研究者只能假设我方特工迅速而见机行事的思路奏了效，因为他们成功地引诱了一艘来自肃正协议威胁的舰队。无论是通过精妙的骇入协议，亦或是通过伪造某种形式的漏洞超载，我们的遥测扫描已经确认§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!之间传来了敌对的信号传输。

无论§Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!在这个纷乱的时间点是否还有其他的顾虑：我们的行动保证他们至少又多了一件事可以操碎他们的心。
descriptions.en:
Our researchers can only speculate upon the quick and adaptive thinking employed by our operatives when they successfully lured a fleet from the ongoing Contingency threat. Whether by an elaborate protocol hacking or by fabricating some sort of loophole override, our remote scans now confirm a hostile presence in transit between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!.

Whether or not the §Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§! have other ongoing concerns during these turbulent times: our actions have ensured they shall have at least one more pressing matter to attend to.

descriptions.zh:
尽管他们最近表现得很团结，§P[raider_khanate.GetName]§!最后还是证明了自己只是头脑简单的猎捕者，轻易就被愤怒钓上了钩。我们的小队想方设法激怒了某位指挥官，后者正甚嚣尘上地以超光速杀向[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!。

我们的特工很确信任何倒霉到竖立在§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]之间的恒星基地都会作为东道主给这支掠夺者小分队表演一下什么叫做热锅上的蚂蚁。让我们希望这次牺牲没有白费。
descriptions.en:
Despite their recent attempts at unity, §Pthe [raider_khanate.GetName]§! have proven an uncomplicated prey to bait in anger. Our team worked hard to antagonize one Commander in particular, whose boiling rage is now being directed at faster-than-light speeds toward the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!.

Our operatives are resolute that any starbase unfortunate enough to lie between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName] will play chaotic host to this small band of marauders. Let us hope this sacrifice is not in vain.

descriptions.zh:
我们对抗§P异次元入侵者§!的努力终于有了成果，尽管代价十分的惨重。我们的特工成功地诱使一支异次元舰队认为他们在[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]领土腹地的一个次元锚正处于威胁。舰队现在正从§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!向§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!开拔。

间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]会继续监视这一形势，但是看样子我们是没法见到我们的特工活着返回了。我们必须密切关注，并相信我们的诱敌方案有利于我们的计划。
descriptions.en:
Our efforts against the §PExtradimensional Invaders§! have paid off, though the cost was certainly steep. Our operatives have successfully duped an extra-dimensional fleet into thinking one of their dimensional anchors is under threat, deep inside [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] territory. Ships are now en route to §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§! from the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§!.

Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will continue to monitor the situation, but it is unlikely we will see our operatives returned to us. We must now watch, and trust that our lure serves our plan.

descriptions.zh:
吸引这个所谓的§P灰蛊风暴§!这样零散的实体的注意力，并不是什么难事。我们的特工成功地通过一个单发的、调制的载波成功地把灰蛊风暴指向了§H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!。

构建这个波充满挑战，因为§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都之间距离很长，使得§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!需要前所未有的能量维持。我们的团队采用了在一个远程发射器的电源组中触发一个不可控的连锁反应。该装置保持在一起的时间刚好足以将我们的诱饵传送到超空间。

长距离遥测显示纳米虫群正向着§Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!前进。我们的研究人员还注意到在[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]附近发生了灾难性爆炸，这应该是我们的那位特工的功劳。
descriptions.en:
Drawing the focused attention of entities as piecemeal as this so-called §PGray Tempest§! was no mean feat. Our operatives succeeded by way of a one-shot, modulating carrier wave pointed squarely in the direction of the §H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!.

Constructing this wave was a fraught effort, as the distance between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§! requires an unprecedented amount of energy. Our team resorted to triggering an uncontrollable chain reaction in the power banks of a long-range transmitter. The device held together just long enough to beam our lure across hyperspace.

Long-distance telemetry suggests that a Nanite Swarm is now making its way towards the §Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!. Our researchers also note readings of a catastrophic explosion in the vicinity of [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] - believed to be the site of our operatives' fatal endeavor.

descriptions.zh:
我们对§P虫群天灾§!的生物引擎研究的时间虽然不长，但是被证明十分有效。我们发明了一种合成化合物——生产起来很昂贵，运输起来也很困难——但是能够成功诱使一支舰队偏离虫群。

这种化合物的附着性是如此之强，我方特工的命运现在就和竖在§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!之间的恒星基地一样惨烈。一旦我方特工释放这种诱骗性的化合物，他们的命就没了。

相比于四散而逃并搅乱虫群的路线，我们的小队决定花费剩余的时间确保没有留下任何行动的痕迹。§H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!很快就会尝到我们的牺牲带来的后果。
descriptions.en:
Our research into the biological drives of the §PPrethoryn Scourge§! was conducted swiftly, but has proven effective. We devised a synthetic compound - expensive to produce, and dangerous to transport - which has succeeded in luring a fleet away from the Swarm.

So adhesive is this compound that the fate of our operatives is now as bleak as that of any starbase which lies between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!. The moment our operatives released the beguiling chemical, their fate was sealed.

Rather than flee and risk confusing the swarm's route, our team will instead spend what remaining time they have ensuring that the trail remains intact. The §H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§! will soon experience the results of our sacrifice.

descriptions.zh:
我们探测到了来自§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!的敌对信号，正朝着我们的首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!笔直地杀过来！奇怪的能量波动从§H[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]§!的附近爆发，我们猜测这是他们的源头。

当这个区域的能量信号突然发生变化时，我们才刚刚开始分析这一现象。所有的信号都显示这是舰队移动突然发生了改变。此外，中间至少有一个能量信号看上去不属于[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]。无论他们是谁，看上去正是他们导致了这样的行为。我们怀疑这是我们的某个星系对手搞得§H祸水东引§!动作。
descriptions.en:
We detect a hostile presence from the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!, heading straight for our capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!! Strange energy waves have burst out from the vicinity of §H[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]§!, their assumed origin.

We had just begun the work of analyzing this phenomenon when energy signatures in the region abruptly changed. All signs suggest this means a sudden change of fleet movements. Furthermore, at least one of those energy signatures looks to belong to an empire other than the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]. Whoever they are, they appear to be the cause of this behavior. We suspect this to be §Hprovocative action§! by one of our galactic rivals.

descriptions.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们失去了活跃于§H[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]§!上的[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]特工的联系。他们已经错过了最近的几次约定的汇报时间。

按照标准程序，我们现在需要决定是否去追踪他们。
descriptions.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the §H[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]§!. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.

In accordance with standard procedure, we must now decide whether or not to track down our own operatives.

暂停§Y[from.GetName]行动§!，时间为一个月。
我们的成功几率取决于目标的§H加密§!等级。
tooltips.en:
Pauses §YOperation [from.GetName]§! for about a month.
Our chances of success depend on the target's §HEncryption§! level.

tooltips.en: Silently §Rcancel§! this operation. Any unspent §HAssets§! will not be consumed.

descriptions.zh: 我们的努力奏效了——同我方特工的联络恢复了。间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经开始着手审核[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]为了在§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!经营而布置好的监视流程。
descriptions.en: Our efforts proved successful - contact with our operatives has been restored. Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is already working to review the monitoring procedures [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] in place for work in the §H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.

options.script: name = GOOD

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们已经尽全力，但我们还是没法恢复与我们在§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!的特工的通讯。间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经下达指令，对我们当地间谍网的监视流程进行一次评估；有可能[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的§H加密§!手段比我们估计的还要高明。

于此同时，§H[fromfrom.GetName]行动§!将以未达到全力的情况下恢复，直到我们补充了损失的部分。
descriptions.en:
Despite our best efforts, we cannot restore contact with our operatives in the §H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!. Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has ordered a review of monitoring procedures for our Spy Network there; it is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] have more sophisticated §HEncryption§! than we had thought.

Meanwhile, §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§! will resume at a reduced capacity while we recoup our losses.

descriptions.zh: 尽管已经像训练时那样准备了所有的预防措施，位于§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的一名我方特工还是提出了对于他们的伪装的担心。特别是在§H[from.GetName]§!行动的关键时刻，决不能暴露出来——因此，间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]请求投入更多资源来使得[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]避免未来的意外发生。
descriptions.en: Despite having taken every precaution prescribed in their training, one of our operatives in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has raised concerns that their cover may be blown. Apparently this comes at a critical time for §HOperation [from.GetName]§! - as such, Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requests more resources with which [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] might prevent disruptions further down the line.

label.zh: 这种风险是很平常的。放着吧。

这次§H[from.GetName]行动§!还是有机会挽回的，但是需要立马对间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]进行援助。

descriptions.zh:
间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]和[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的同事们消除了因我们特工入侵§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!产生的尴尬。

有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。
descriptions.en:
Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] and [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] colleagues have smoothed over our operatives' awkward intrusion into the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.

It's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] sees our excuses for the pack of lies they are. As far as outward appearances are concerned, however: we are considered to be 'in the clear'.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_hive_empire = no }

descriptions.zh:
我们已经通过外交斡旋解决了我们侵入§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!所引起的一些外交误会。

有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。
descriptions.en:
We have successfully negotiated our way out of the diplomatically awkward intrusion into the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.

It's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] does not lend any credibility to our excuses at all, but from an outside perspective: we are considered to be 'in the clear' for now.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_hive_empire = yes }

options.script: name = GOOD

descriptions.zh: 当特工在稳步进入§H[from.target.GetName]§!更加戒备森严的区域时，我们失去了与其的联系。我们搞不好会全部交代在这里。这样的信号中断可能是马虎的[from.target.GetAdj]启动了屏蔽科技，隔断了我们的噪声干涉。
descriptions.en: We are losing contact with our operatives as they enter steadily more secure areas in the §H[from.target.GetName]§!. There is a chance we could lose our presence there altogether. These interruptions are likely caused by sloppy [from.target.GetAdj] shielding technology putting out noisy interference.

label.zh: 我们应当尝试并去适应。
label.en: We shall have to try and adapt.

tooltips.zh: 我方行动可能成功，也可能遭受挫折，成功率取决于我们的相对§Y科技等级§!。
tooltips.en: We may succeed or suffer operational setbacks, depending somewhat on our relative §Ytechnology level§!.

label.zh: 让他们自己的硬件转而对付他们。
label.en: Turn their own hardware against them.

tooltips.zh: §R耗尽§!我方间谍网中的线人会让进度恢复。
tooltips.en: §RExpending§! our Spy Network Asset will allow progress to resume.

descriptions.zh:
我们失去了指派给对于§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!的§H[fromfrom.GetName]行动§!中所有人员的联系。无论是被我们的目标算计，还是单纯遇到了不幸的巧合，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的屏蔽科技都是一个相当棘手的对手。

[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName]在这场事件中存在获得收益的可能性。尽管我们的特工[GetOperativesLowerPlural]能够做到半自主，但是没有了我们的出面引导，这些子个体可能会更加容易落到敌人手中。
descriptions.en:
We have lost all contact with our operatives assigned to §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§! in the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!. Whether by our target's cunning design, or simply an unlucky coincidence for us, [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] shielding technology has proven a worthy adversary us.

It is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] may gain from this incident. Although our [GetOperativesLowerPlural] may operate semi-autonomously, without our presence they are still far more vulnerable to enemy capture.

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.target.GetName]§!的一个主脑错误地把我们的特工认定为食物，现在正热情洋溢地在狩猎它们。这种特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesName][from.target.GetIndividualName]似乎会本能地会把除自己以外的任何个体当作潜在的营养来源。
descriptions.en: A primal aspect of the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! entity has mistaken our operatives for food, and is now fixated upon hunting them. This particular [from.target.GetSpeciesName] [from.target.GetIndividualName] seems to instinctively regard anything other than itself as a source of potential nutrition.

label.zh: 继续行动！我们会适应这个，然后生存下去。
label.en: Keep moving! We adapt and survive.

label.zh: 将猎手反杀。部署§Y作战子个体§!。
label.en: Hunt the hunter. Deploy the §YWarrior Drone§!.

tooltips.zh: §R耗尽§!我方间谍网中的线人会让进度恢复。
tooltips.en: §RExpending§! our Spy Network Asset will allow progress to resume.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.target.GetName]§!的生存环境似乎对我们派遣到§H[from.GetName]行动§!中的[GetIndividualNamePlural]有轻微的毒性。我们的特工已经开始出现症状，哪怕是最轻的症状都开始损坏他们的正常功能，而最坏的情况则是被敌对[from.target.GetGestaltEntityName]给逮到。
descriptions.en: Something about the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! living environment appears mildly toxic to the [GetIndividualNamePlural] assigned to §HOperation [from.GetName]§!. Our operative is beginning to show symptoms which at best impair their function, and at worst single them out within the hostile [from.target.GetGestaltEntityName].

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.target.GetName]§!的生存环境发生了微妙的改变，这再次对我们产生了轻微的毒性。我们的特工已经开始出现症状，哪怕是最轻的症状都开始损坏他们的正常功能，而最坏的情况则是被敌对[from.target.GetGestaltEntityName]给逮到。
descriptions.en: There has been a subtle change within the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! living environment, which has once again become mildly toxic to us. Our operative is beginning to show symptoms which at best impair their function, and at worst single them out within the hostile [from.target.GetGestaltEntityName].

label.zh: 我们必须尽快继续行动。

tooltips.zh: 存在一定风险，使在§Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§!开展的所有特工行动在一段时间内变得§R更加困难§!，直到我们成功开发了抗体。
tooltips.en: There is a risk that all Operations conducted in the §Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§! may become §Rmore difficult§! for a time, until we can develop antibodies.

descriptions.zh: 我们研究人员的努力有了成果，治疗特效药被分发给了我们的子个体特工。§Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§!居住地发现的那种低浓度毒素应该不会再给我们的§H[event_target:toxic_field_operation.GetName]行动§!造成困扰了。
descriptions.en: Our research efforts have paid off, and remedies are being distributed to our drone operatives. The low-level toxins found in §Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§! habitats should no longer present any issues, and §HOperation [event_target:toxic_field_operation.GetName]§! may continue.

options.script: name = GOOD

descriptions.zh: 我们在§Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§!的机会之窗已经关闭了！我们的子个体已经难以承受环境的影响。§H[fromfromfrom.GetName]行动§!会继续，但我们必须小心行事以避免我们的特工被怀疑。
descriptions.en: Our window of opportunity inside the §Y[toxic_field_country.GetName]§! has closed, leaving our operative drones visibly affected by their environment. §HOperation [fromfromfrom.GetName]§! may continue, but we must work carefully lest our allergies arouse suspicion.

descriptions.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境充满了静电噪声——比我们预测的要多得多。我们向§H[from.GetName]行动§!派遣的伪装无人机正在经历间歇性的数据丢失。这会导致我们数据收集风险的显著上升，从而增加了我们暴露的概率。
descriptions.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has become riddled with electrostatic noise - far more than we had anticipated. The disguised drones we have assigned to §HOperation [from.GetName]§! are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. This poses significant risks to our data-gathering, and increases our chances of exposure.

descriptions.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境再一次充满了静电噪声，我们对这样的频率尚且不能适应。我们向§H[from.GetName]行动§!派遣的伪装无人机正在经历间歇性的数据丢失。这会导致我们数据收集风险的显著上升，从而增加了我们暴露的概率。
descriptions.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has once again become riddled with electrostatic noise, in frequencies we are not yet accustomed to. The disguised drones we have assigned to §HOperation [from.GetName]§! are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. This poses significant risks to our data-gathering, and increases our chances of exposure.

label.zh: 我们必须尽快继续行动。

tooltips.zh: 存在一定风险，使在§Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§!开展的所有特工行动在一段时间内变得§R更加困难§!，直到我们的硬件产生了适应性。
tooltips.en: There is a risk that all Operations conducted in the §Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§! may become §Rmore difficult§! for a time, until we can adapt our hardware.

descriptions.zh: 我们的研究努力取得了回报，新的电磁屏蔽护盾参数已经分发到了我们位于§Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§!的间谍网中。我们§H[fromfromfrom.GetName]行动§!的工作将不会在遇到阻碍。
descriptions.en: Our research efforts have paid off, and specifications for new shielding against electromagnetic interference are being distributed throughout our operative network in the §Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§!. Our efforts on §HOperation [fromfromfrom.GetName]§! should no longer be hindered by excess static.

options.script: name = GOOD

descriptions.zh: 在§Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§!上的电磁杂波已经导致了我们的一些特工的不可逆转的数据损失。§H[event_target:excess_noise_operation.GetName]行动§!或许可以继续，但我们的工作将被拖延——需要相当的工作量来保证我们的数据可信。
descriptions.en: Electrostatic noise in the §Y[excess_noise_country.GetName]§! has now caused irreparable data loss amongst some of our drones. §HOperation [event_target:excess_noise_operation.GetName]§! may continue, but our efforts are being hindered - such is the scale of backlogged demands upon our data validation processes.

descriptions.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们位于§Y[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!附近的特工小队已经错过了几个检查点。考虑到这次行动的性质，我们预料到他们不能维持频繁的联系。然而，虽然感到遗憾，我们的间谍首脑坚信这支小队是失踪了。

如果我们能够成功地掩盖痕迹，§H[from.GetName]行动§!可能被挽救。我们得发挥我们的§H破译§!对抗[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]的§H加密§!的优势。
descriptions.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our team of operatives near the §Y[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has missed a number of checkpoints. Given the nature of this operation, we had already anticipated them being unable to maintain frequent contact. However, our Spymaster is regrettably confident that by now, the team has been lost.

§HOperation [from.GetName]§! may be rescued if we can successfully cover our tracks, pitting our §HCodebreaking§! against [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] §HEncryption§!.

tooltips.zh:
暂停§Y[from.GetName]行动§!，持续时间一个月。

我们的行动有§H低到中§!的几率不会被注意到。被发现几率取决于§H加密§!。

如果我们派遣与该行动§Y次要类别§!相对应的§Y线人§!，那么成功的概率就会相应地提高。
tooltips.en:
Pauses §YOperation [from.GetName]§! for about a month.

There is a §Hmedium-to-low§! chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on our target's §HEncryption§!.

Success is more likely if we have an §YAsset§! assigned to this Operation, sharing the same §Ysecondary category§!.

tooltips.zh:
§R取消§!§Y[from.GetName]行动§!。

我们的行动有§G高§!几率不会被注意到。被发现几率取决于§H加密§!。

如果我们派遣与该行动§Y主要类别§!相对应的§Y线人§!，那么成功的概率就会相应地提高。
tooltips.en:
§RCancels§! §YOperation [from.GetName]§!.

There is a §Ghigh§! chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on the target's §HEncryption§!.

Success is more likely if we have an §YAsset§! assigned to this Operation, sharing the same §Yprimary category§!.

descriptions.zh:
尽管耗费了大量人力物力，消耗了许多间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在§H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!积累的成果，我们终于确保了行动的安全性。所有松动的口子都被堵上；所有掩护身份都被抛弃掉。一支全新的特工队伍将替代原来的人员，在我们的间谍首脑亲自注视下执行着完全不同指令。

与此同时，[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]依然没有注意到我方的存在。
descriptions.en:
Though it has greatly taxed the resources of Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]'s work in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!, operational security has been reasserted. All loose ends have been covered; all cover identities discarded. A new team of operatives will take over from here, enacting a subtly different set of orders under our Spymaster's watchful gaze.

The [snuffedout_country.GetAdj], meanwhile, still seem oblivious to our presence.

options.script: name = GOOD

descriptions.zh:
我们最担心的事情成了真：我们最近在§H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!失去的特工曝光了我们大部分§H[fromfrom.GetName]行动§!的细节。

我们的全部间谍网都经过了妥善安排，确保在正常情况下，只有极其不周密的证据才会追溯到我们执行的隐秘行动。然而，在当下的情况，我们完全无法确认何种情报已经泄露；也没法知道[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]打算如何进行回应。
descriptions.en:
Our worst fears have come to pass: the recent loss of our operatives in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has exposed large parts of §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§!.

All our Spy Networks are carefully arranged so that under normal circumstances, only very flimsy evidence could ever implicate us in the covert activities we carry out. However, in this instance we cannot be entirely sure what Intel may have been given away; nor can we know how the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] might choose to respond.

descriptions.zh:
我们最近在§H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!损失的特工酿成了严重的后果：我方的整个行动被暴露了。

我们的间谍网处于妥善管理的状态，保证正常情况下，能够为我方特工提供一定的匿名性。然而，在当下的情况，我方的任何行动都会导致严重后果，因为各类证据会导向我们，而[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]绝不会对此坐视不管。我们不知道他们会如何回应，得我们应该做好最坏的打算。
descriptions.en:
The recent loss of our operatives in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has had some dire consequences: our entire operation has been exposed.

Our Spy Networks are carefully managed so that under normal circumstances, they afford us some level of deniability. However, on this occasion our actions were serious enough that the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] are unlikely to ignore even circumstantial evidence which may lead back to us. We do not know precisely how they will respond, but we should prepare for the worst.

descriptions.zh:
最近间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在察觉到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!上的特工表现失常后对[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]发起了一场调查。

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap][from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave]这才发现这些特工对用于情报搜集与贿赂的资源雁过拔毛。他们将这些物资与货币投资到了[from.target.GetAdj]上的生意场上以损公肥私。因此，他们的追求与忠诚背道而驰。

在间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]重整部门风气前，有关§H行动[from.GetName]§!的一切项目均被暂时搁置。
descriptions.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] recently launched a quiet investigation into [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] own operatives in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, after noticing a recent drop in their performance.

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap] [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] discovered these operatives skimming from resources allocated to intelligence-gathering and bribes. These goods and currencies are being re-invested elsewhere in [from.target.GetAdj] business concerns, earning the operatives a comfortable profit at our expense. As a result, their attention and loyalties have clearly become divided.

Progress on §HOperation [from.GetName]§! has been put on hold for the moment, until Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] can re-assert operational efficiency.

label.zh: 是可忍孰不可忍，给予其强烈斥责。
label.en: This cannot be tolerated. Issue reprimands.

label.zh: 我们可以化腐朽为神奇。
label.en: This could give us an interesting edge.

descriptions.zh: 我们位于§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!上的特工不再使用我们间谍网的资源。对效忠对象的坚定提醒，重新激发了特工们的奉献精神；他们将把他们的聪明才智完全用于我们的事业。
descriptions.en: Our operatives in the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§! are no longer skimming resources from our Spy Network allocation. Firm reminders of just where their loyalties lie have reinvigorated the operatives' sense of dedication; they will turn their resourceful talents wholly to our cause.

options.script:
name = GOOD
fromfrom.spynetwork = { add_spy_network_level = 2 }

descriptions.zh:
间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]遗憾的报告：我们失去了§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!上的间谍网。

当我们特工中的一群小偷被要求解释原因时，他们的反应是逃跑——分散到[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的宇域里，那些甚至连我们都难以监控的地方。[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]不再能够追踪他们——至少没法在不引发注意的情况下找到。
descriptions.en:
Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] regretfully reports a breakdown in our §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§! Spy Network.

When a group of thieves amongst our operatives was called to account, their response was to flee - scattering to parts of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] space that even we struggle to monitor. [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is no longer able to track them down - at least not without drawing undue attention.

descriptions.zh:
我们位于§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的间谍首脑，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]，向我们报告了在[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]内筛查特工项目上的惨痛失败。来自[from.target.GetAdj]首都的发言显示[root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle]已经选择§R叛逃§!。

看上去[root.GetOperativeRole]对于[from.target.GetName]的文化和主体物种生出了同情，而背离了我们。我们的审查机制本来应该排除掉这样的异样，但是这次却失败了。
descriptions.en:
Our Spymaster in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle] has chosen to §Rdefect§!.

It seems that the [root.GetOperativeRole] has grown more sympathetic towards the culture and founding ethics of the [from.target.GetName], in opposition to our own. Our screening process has failed in that it is supposed to rule out such flakiness.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_country_flag = operative_defects_culture }

descriptions.zh:
我们位于§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的间谍首脑，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]，向我们报告了在[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]内筛查特工项目上的惨痛失败。来自[from.target.GetAdj]首都的发言显示[root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle]已经选择§R叛逃§!。

尽管我们本应当通过审查排除掉组织里的不忠，但[root.GetOperativeRole]还是被“变节”了——或是通过反间谍行动，或是通过培养对[from.target.GetName]的同情意识，而我们之前并没有注意到。
descriptions.en:
Our Spymaster in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle] has chosen to §Rdefect§!.

Despite the fact we are supposed to be able to screen out such disloyalty, the [root.GetOperativeRole] has been 'turned' - either by act of Counter-Espionage, or some innate sympathy towards [from.target.GetName] which we were unable to detect before.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_country_flag = operative_defects_turned }

一位位于§Y[from.target.owner.GetName]§!的特工触发了安装在[from.target.GetName]恒星基地服务管道内的防篡改装置。

他身受重伤，但还是勉力完成了任务，而且到目前为止仍未被发现。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们特工呆在他们那疗伤越久就越容易暴露。
descriptions.en:
An operative in the §Y[from.target.owner.GetName]§! has fallen foul of an anti-tampering device, installed in the service ducts of the [from.target.GetName] starbase.

Their injuries are severe, but our operative managed to complete their task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains in their medical care, the greater the risk our cover will be blown.

The drone has sustained serious damage, but has completed its task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains under their supervision, the greater the risk of exposure.

descriptions.zh:
一位位于§Y[from.target.owner.GetName]§!的特工触发了安装在[from.target.GetName]恒星基地服务管道内的防篡改装置。

他现在没法跑太远，除非我们在行动接下来的时间中给予除基本支援外的更多援助，这样他才能确保找到一个足够安全的藏身处。然而不久之后这片区域肯定会进行清理式扫荡。我们的特工呆在[from.target.owner.GetAdj]疆域下越久，暴露的危险就越大。
descriptions.en:
An operative in the §Y[from.target.owner.GetName]§! has fallen foul of an anti-tampering device, installed in the service ducts of the [from.target.GetName] starbase.

They are currently unable to move far or else lend more than basic support to the rest of the operation, so they have secured a reasonably safe hideout. There is, however, bound to be a maintenance sweep of the area before long. The longer our operative remains in [from.target.owner.GetAdj] care, the greater the risk of exposure.

label.zh: 我们必须抛下他继续前进。

descriptions.zh:
一队位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工开始回避分配给他们的任务，并声称他们对目标总体而言缺乏信心。间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]通常会在不引起我们注意的情况下就处理好这些事情，但其实他自己并没有深入了解其中的细节：这些特工似乎对于§H[from.GetName]行动§!甚至是整个间谍网都过分了解。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们那些更活跃的知情代理人保持着一定距离，[operation.leader.GetName]怀疑这些特工很有可能是从外界获取的信息。但[operation.leader.GetHeSheCap]同样也承认可能只是他们的洞察力过分敏锐罢了。

基于以上怀疑，以及各种猜测对于[from.GetName]行动可能的威胁，间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]请求指示接下来该如何进行。
descriptions.en:
A group of auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! has begun shying away from their assigned tasks, citing a lack of confidence in their overall purpose. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] would typically handle such matters without bringing them to our attention, but even without them knowing any details: these operatives seem unusually well-informed about §HOperation [from.GetName]§!, and perhaps the spy network as a whole.

Given that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active and better-informed agents, [operation.leader.GetName] suspects the operatives are being fed information from an outside source. [operation.leader.GetHeSheCap] also concede[operation.leader.GetSXX] that they may simply be highly perceptive individuals.

Given these doubts - and the threats posed to Operation [from.GetName] by each scenario - Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] requests a directive on how to proceed.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_gestalt = no }

descriptions.zh:
一组位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工在执行分配给它们的任务时进度开始滞后，并做出一些能被解析为怀疑的行动。我们通常直接命令间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]来解决此事，但这些特工表现得它们似乎能察觉到§H行动[from.GetName]§!中所埋藏的阴谋，也许还有整个间谍网也在它们的知情范围内。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们更为活跃的代理个体保持隔离，我们怀疑有外部势力在向它们灌输信息。然而，如果可能的话，它们与自主代理个体的趋同或许能够赋予它们自己一种我们今后有机会将其利用到的洞察力。

基于以上怀疑，以及各种猜测对于[from.GetName]行动可能的威胁，间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]请求指示接下来该如何进行。
descriptions.en:
A group of auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! has begun lagging in their assigned tasks, displaying behavior which could be interpreted as doubt. We would typically handle such matters directly through Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName], but this group acts as though it can perceive the wider machinations of §HOperation [from.GetName]§!, and perhaps the spy network as a whole.

Given that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active agents, we suspect they are being fed information from an outside source. It is, however, also possible that their proximity to independent agents may simply have endowed these operatives with the kind of insight we may one day find useful.

Given these doubts - and the threats posed to Operation [from.GetName] by each scenario - Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] requests a directive on how to proceed.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_gestalt = yes }

label.en: The risks are too great; cut them loose.

label.zh: 那就让我们看看这些“洞察力”会带来什么吧。
label.en: Let us see where these 'insights' may lead.

descriptions.zh: 我们位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工们在发现自己从前难以形容的怀疑并不是无中生有后，便以加倍的热情投入进工作中。间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]仍然对他们维持了严格的信息屏蔽，但报告称[operation.leader.GetHisHer]的运作变得前所未有的流畅。
descriptions.en: Our auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! have applied themselves with unusual fervor upon learning that their once-intangible suspicions were founded in a real cause after all. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] maintains a strict information quarantine, but reports that [operation.leader.GetHisHer] supply lines have never been smoother.

descriptions.zh: 在得知此前难以形容的怀疑并非无中生有后，我们位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工表现得惊惧起来。间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]仅仅只是向他们透露了些许关于全局的信息，就足以打乱行动的运作。现在我们破坏[target_country.GetAdj]加密的能力将在接下来的一段时间内下降。
descriptions.en: Our auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! have reacted with horror upon learning the truth of their once-intangible suspicions. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] revealed only a glimpse of the bigger picture to them, but it was sufficient to disrupt our supply lines. Our ability to subvert [target_country.GetAdj] Encryption is reduced for a time.

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工已经完成了情报收集行动，并发送回来一封内容翔实的报告，涵盖他们发现的所有信息。
descriptions.en: Our operatives have completed their information-gathering operation and have sent a dossier detailing their findings.
